settings.heading: Materials
settings.content: Cotton body and clothes, wool felt shoes, carded wool stuffing, cotton embroidery thread.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Clothes can be hand washed in cool water and dried flat.

settings.heading: Shipping and returns
settings.content: Each doll is made to order and ships within about a week. Unused dolls can be returned within 30 days.
